releases.notes:
### English

- Add lazy directory-range indexing in `ResourcePathIndex`, compact indexing for `VanillaPackResources`, shared ZIP overlay indexing on `SharedZipFileAccess`, and empty sub-pack short-circuiting across `FallbackResourceManager`, `DelegatingPackResources`, and `CompositePackResources`.
- Remove lock contention in `MultiPackResourceManager` resource listing caches on 1.21.1+ and reuse cached `FileToIdConverter.listMatchingResourceStacks` lookups during initial reload.
- Avoid materializing the full blockstate hash table in `ModelLocationSets.IndexedLocationSet` during bulk block population and subsequent item/standalone additions, optimize `StateVariantSupport` lookups for large blockstate tables, switch `BitSetVoxelUnion` to word-level bit operations, make `ObjectHolderDispatch` updates incremental, and narrow `FontWarmupSnapshot` provider probing.
- Check the lock-free early mod index before the Agent fallback in Forge `PathResourcePackMixin` to avoid redundant archive view creation, and add NeoForge 1.21.1 `SecureJarHandler` (`Jar$JarModuleDataProvider`) direct path lookup support in the Bootstrap Agent.

### 中文

- 为 `ResourcePathIndex` 新增懒建目录区间索引，为原版 `VanillaPackResources` 新增紧凑索引，将 ZIP 索引下沉至 `SharedZipFileAccess` 供 overlay 共享，并在 `FallbackResourceManager`、`DelegatingPackResources` 与 `CompositePackResources` 中跳过空命名空间与空目录子包调用。
- 消除 1.21.1+ `MultiPackResourceManager` 资源列表缓存的 `ConcurrentHashMap` 桶锁竞争，并复用首次重载期间的 `FileToIdConverter.listMatchingResourceStacks` 查询。
- 避免 `ModelLocationSets.IndexedLocationSet` 在批量写入方块状态及追加物品/独立模型时构建完整方块状态哈希表；优化大状态集方块的 `StateVariantSupport` 查找、将 `BitSetVoxelUnion` 改为字级位运算、使 `ObjectHolderDispatch` 增量追加更新，并缩减 `FontWarmupSnapshot` 提供方探测次数。
- 调整 Forge `PathResourcePackMixin` 优先走零分配早期索引以避免 Agent 模式下重复创建归档视图，并在 Bootstrap Agent 中补齐 NeoForge 1.21.1 `SecureJarHandler`（`Jar$JarModuleDataProvider`）的直接路径读取补丁。

## Lightspeed 2.0.11

### Release & Packaging
- Publish full 8-target release coverage across Forge 1.20.1, NeoForge 1.21.1, Fabric 1.20.1, Fabric 1.21.1, Fabric 26.1.2, NeoForge 26.1.2, Fabric 26.2, and NeoForge 26.2.
- Declare compatible Minecraft version ranges (`[26.1.2,26.2)` and `[26.2,26.3)`) in NeoForge 26.1.2 and NeoForge 26.2 metadata instead of single-version constraints.
- Includes all 2.0.10 startup cache, loader-native pack indexing, shader snapshotting, mipmap fast-path, and `.lsc` digest-based persistence improvements.

releases.notes:
## Lightspeed 2.0.10

### Startup & Resource Loading
- Activate loader-native single-JAR mod pack indexing on Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1 without requiring a JVM agent, move early ZIP pre-indexing off the main thread with reusable decode buffers, and release startup registries and archive handles upon reaching the title screen.
- Move `UnionFileSystem` construction out of the `UnionFileSystemProvider` monitor lock and use FIFO scheduling for the Forge/NeoForge `ModWorkManager` worker pool while preserving mod topological order.
- Replace per-lookup `ResourceLocation.toString()` overhead in `VanillaPackResources` with a startup-only direct lookup cache.
- Skip rewriting unchanged `.lsc` cache files via content digest comparison, prune only stale files, and remove per-file `fsync` calls.

### Rendering, Assets & Runtime Overhead
- Add parallel mipmap generation and fast-path mipmap / opaque sprite handling (including Sodium/Embeddium compatibility).
- Add GLSL `#moj_import`-aware shader program binary snapshotting across Forge 1.20.1, NeoForge 1.21.1, Fabric 1.20.1, and Fabric 1.21.1.
- Remove disk/SHA-256 snapshot overhead from font warmup while retaining a pre-sized reverse-array warmup pass.
- Remove boxed `Material` and `ResourceLocation` `hashCode()` Mixin injections, eliminate `GlobalCache.add` monitor contention and per-entry cleanup task storms, and reduce `StateDefinition` and multipart `Selector` startup allocations.
- Switch opt-in `NativeImageSnapshot` payload checksums to hardware-accelerated CRC32C with zero-copy read views and post-startup heap release.
- Declare compatible Minecraft SemVer ranges (`~1.20.1`, `~1.21.1`) in Fabric metadata.

## Forge 1.20.1

- Fixed a crash when a mod registers a key mapping with a null category. Verified on Forge 47.4.29 with Laser Creeper Robot Dino Riders From Space 3.0.0.
- Retains the registry holder compatibility for Forge releases that provide native per-registry dispatch.

## NeoForge 1.21.1

- An empty resource-listing prefix now enumerates the namespace root, including nested files. Verified with directory packs and mod JARs on NeoForge 21.1.267. Invalid paths still receive the normal diagnostic. See [#29](https://github.com/kltyton/LightSpeedRe/issues/29).
